look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Check the axillary pale-yellow, five-lobed flowers and especially the fruit: the enlarging green papery calyx encloses a berry and becomes distinctly angled/ribbed. Check alternate, often irregularly toothed leaves and angular branching stems. Compare the floral throat, calyx ribs, leaf margin and hairiness with other groundcherries; a husk alone is not a species-level ID.
diagnostic_image_needs: Close view of open corolla and anthers for comparison with other Physalis
Close view of fully inflated calyx showing ribs and berry position
Stem and leaf surface/hairs plus leaf-margin details
lookalike_note: Other Physalis species are possible; compare calyx ribbing, corolla markings, hairiness and leaves. Do not assert a particular local look-alike without morphological evidence.
